description: This file defines the NodeVisitorInterface for Twig, which specifies the methods for node visitor classes in the Twig templating engine. It includes method signatures for entering and leaving nodes during traversal, as well as retrieving the visitor's priority.

classes.name: Twig\NodeVisitor\NodeVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for node visitor classes defining methods for entering and leaving nodes and retrieving priority.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Called before child nodes are visited; returns the (possibly modified) node.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Called after child nodes are visited; returns the (possibly modified) node or null to remove it.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of this visitor, used to determine visitation order.
